title: ReCALM: A Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism for Distributed Continual Service Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.19276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Crowdsourcing has emerged as a promising paradigm for constructing AI services by harnessing the collective capabilities of distributed workers. As consumers' demands continually evolve, service models must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. However, due to the inherited reliance on gradients for backpropagation, existing approaches typically suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual model updates on heterogeneous data. Recent studies have introduced analytic learning, a gradient-free paradigm that achieves invariance through recursive closed-form solutions. Nevertheless, existing analytic methods are typically constrained by single-layer linear networks, which tend to suffer from underfitting due to their inability to perform deep representation learning. To address this issue, we propose ReCALM, a Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism that achieves deep nonlinear invari

translated_title: ReCALM：一种面向分布式持续服务构建的残差增强型众包解析学习机制
translated_abstract: 众包通过利用分布式工作者的集体能力，已成为构建AI服务的一种有前景的范式。随着消费者需求的不断演变，服务模型必须在获取新知识的同时保留先前学习到的信息。然而，由于对梯度反向传播的固有依赖，现有方法在异构数据上的持续模型更新过程中通常会出现灾难性遗忘问题。最近的研究引入了解析学习，这是一种通过递归闭式解实现不变性的无梯度范式。然而，现有的解析方法通常受限于单层线性网络，由于无法进行深度表示学习，往往容易欠拟合。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ReCALM，一种残差增强型众包解析学习机制，能够实现深度非线性不变（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ReCALM，一种残差增强型众包解析学习机制，通过引入深度非线性表示能力克服传统解析学习受限于单层线性网络而导致的欠拟合问题，同时保持无梯度的闭式递归求解以避免异构数据持续更新中的灾难性遗忘，从而支持分布式众包环境下的持续AI服务构建。
en_tdlr: ReCALM is a residual-enhanced crowdsourced analytic learning mechanism that overcomes the underfitting limitation of single-layer linear analytic networks through deep nonlinear representation learning, while preserving gradient-free recursive closed-form solutions to avoid catastrophic forgetting during continual updates on heterogeneous data for distributed AI service construction.
